rationale: Notifications are disabled so cancel_job of a running job cannot interrupt as documented, forcing poll-fetch vs cancel vs complete races. Single-cancel isolates pending-cancel vs running-cancel vs completion-overwrite with max_attempts 1 vs 2 (retry/succeeded/failed confusion). Two-job mixes isolate cancel-running-while-pending-waits vs cancel-pending-while-running-executes vs double-cancel where second fetch, completion of first, and ordered cancels interleave, exposing lost update, duplicate fetch/execution, and cancelled/succeeded overwrite with and without retry allowance. Handler never fails so any retry/failed or missing/duplicate n*2 indicates bug.
